filter_source.target_vendor_model: TraceGas-HC-NDIR (Shenzhen Trace Gas Sensing Technology Co., Ltd.) — actual datasheet pending
filter_source.ch4_reference: InfraTec LIM-262 pyroelectric methane detector NBP filter, CWL 3.3 um, FWHM 160 nm (~147 cm-1 at 3.3 um). Cited in MDPI Sensors 2012, doi:10.3390/s120912729.
filter_source.co2_reference: InfraTec standard CO2 NBP filter, CWL 4.26-4.27 um, HPBW 170 nm (~93 cm-1 at 4.26 um). InfraTec gas analysis docs (infratec-infrared.com).
filter_source.co_reference: InfraTec I (NBP 4.66 um / 180 nm FWHM, CO centered), cross-verified with Boston Electronics HIS-E222-F3.91/4.64 (4.64 um / 180 nm) and MicroHybrid MTS4SENS44-3C-1 (4.65 um / 180 nm). CWL 4.66 um -> 2145.92 cm-1, FWHM 180 nm @ 4.66 um -> 82.89 cm-1. Source: https://www.infratec.eu/sensor-division/ir-filters/ ; https://shop.boselec.com/products/his-e222-f3-91-4-64-g4300-dual-integrated-thermopile-sensor

notes: Filter center_cm1 and fwhm_cm1 are industry-reference placeholders, not the actual datasheet of the target TraceGas-HC-NDIR series sensor.

ch4 fwhm_cm1=147 derives from InfraTec LIM-262 NBP filter 3.3 um / 160 nm FWHM; co2 fwhm_cm1=93 derives from InfraTec standard CO2 NBP filter 4.26 um / 170 nm HPBW; co fwhm_cm1=82.89 derives from InfraTec I 4.66 um / 180 nm (CO basic fundamental band 2143 cm-1).
Replace center_cm1 / fwhm_cm1 with the vendor datasheet of the actual sensor (e.g., TraceGas-HC-NDIR) before any formal benchmark or publication run.
hitran_grids now cover at least center +/- FWHM for the current industry-reference filters. Re-run HITRAN precompute after this grid change because previous local cache windows were narrower.

syngas.* keeps the syngas (4-component) HITRAN configuration isolated from hg. Top-level gas_specs / filters / hitran_grids remain hg-only and unchanged. hg DEFAULT_HITRAN_GAS_SPECS stays (CH4, CO2, H2O) so hg cache requirements do not expand.

syngas.channel_gas_specs declares which gases participate in each NDIR channel forward model. ch4/co2 channels stay hg-compatible; co channel uses (CO, CO2, H2O) so CH4 (no fundamental absorption in [1980, 2310]) is not required.

syngas co grid [1980, 2310] cm-1 covers the CO fundamental band (P/R branches 2000-2230 cm-1) plus CO2 4.3 um band lower wing for 3x3 crosstalk. Spectral cache files are keyed by (gas, wmin, wmax, step) so hg ch4/co2 caches are unaffected.
HAPI fetch validation: fetch('CO', 5, 1, 1980, 2310) should return ~1344 main-isotope lines with Smax ~4.56e-19 cm/molec at 296 K.
